name: argusmetrics-css
description: Tailwind build for the dashboard and the marketing site. See tailwind.config.js.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i backend/app/static/css/input.css -o backend/app/static/css/tailwind.min.css --minify && cp backend/app/static/css/tailwind.min.css site/static/css/tailwind.min.css && node scripts/version-site-assets.js
scripts.check:css: npm run build:css --silent && git diff --exit-code -- backend/app/static/css/tailwind.min.css site/static/css/tailwind.min.css site/
